title: Marathon Snorkeling and Sandbar Adventure
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover the best of the Florida Keys with a thrilling snorkeling and sandbar adventure from Marathon Mermaid. Begin at the stunning Sombrero Reef, where vibrant coral and tropical fish await beneath the clear blue waters. No matter your skill level, this snorkeling excursion promises unforgettable underwater sights. After your underwater exploration, glide over to a picturesque sandbar to continue the fun—swim, kayak, paddleboard, or simply soak up the sun in a serene island setting. With snorkel gear, kayaks, paddleboards, complimentary drinks, and light snacks provided, this trip is a perfect blend of adventure and relaxation.
